name: o91148

fallback.description: A loader that webpack can fall back to if the original one fails.

filename.description: The filename and path that ExtractTextPlugin will extract to

ignoreOrder.description: Ignore dependency order (useful for CSS Modules)

loader.description: The loader that ExtractTextPlugin will attempt to load through.

description: The ExtractTextPlugin is configured to extract every chunk from the bundle ( allChunks = true ) and the plugin remains active ( disable = false ). If the primary loader chain fails, it will fall back to the **style-loader**. Extracted styles are written to the path `css/[name].css`, and the public URL prefix for these assets is set to `/static/`. The loader sequence applied to the CSS files consists of **css-loader** followed by **postcss-loader**, and the plugin is set to respect the original dependency order ( ignoreOrder = false ).
